# Wellinks is redefining how cardiopulmonary care is delivered.

The Wellinks solution combines virtual chronic care management with remote patient monitoring using its proprietary, FDA-cleared Spire Remote Patient Monitoring System. Leveraging data-driven insights with proactive clinical support, Wellinks' care model is focused on reducing acute care utilization, readmissions, and total cost of care.

[For Payers & Providers](https://www.wellinks.com/payers-providers)

## Wellinks Has Reinvented the Delivery of Cardiopulmonary Care

COPD-related hospitalizations are common, costly, and often avoidable. The Wellinks solution integrates continuous passive monitoring from the Health Tag when worn with preemptive notifications from the Spire RPM System to assist care teams in identifying risk and intervening sooner.

[Learn More](https://www.wellinks.com/spire)

## Evidence-Based Interventions Support Better Outcomes

Each member receives an individualized care plan supported by a multidisciplinary virtual care team. When the Health Tag is worn as instructed, the Spire RPM System collects respiratory rate, pulse rate, and activity data for monitoring.

![home outcomes image ](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6aa0e6bc197dd98b6cf294a3_home%20outcomes%20image%20.svg)

Delivered through virtual appointments, asynchronous coaching, educational resources, and 24/7 nurse triage.

## Comprehensive Virtual Care Centered on Each Member

Our care team helps members understand their conditions, develops individualized care plans, and supports engagement between visits. Each member's goals remain at the center of care.

## A Platform That Unifies Data, Insights, and Clinical Pathways

Wellinks brings together population-level information, data, and evidence-based care pathways to support informed and individualized care.

![Rules based engine](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6aa0f413872b16dbe1228f86_Rules%20based%20engine.png)

Rules based engine

Uses available claims, ADT, demographic, and patient-reported information to support population segmentation and care-team review.

![Health Tag](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6aa0f526103a27afa18f701b_Health%20Tag.png)

Health Tag

Collects physiologic data for longitudinal monitoring of pulse rate, respiratory rate, and activity associated with movement while worn as instructed.

![Cardiopulmonary care platform](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67080905769fb0fc5f37e534/6aa0f5371861a45c3458392b_Cardiopulmonary%20care%20platform.png)

Cardiopulmonary care platform

Brings monitored data and evidence-based care pathways together to support care-team review, care coordination, and individualized interventions.

## Bring Proactive Cardiopulmonary Care to Your Population

Wellinks helps health plans, providers, and health systems extend virtual COPD care beyond the clinic by combining remote patient monitoring, pulmonary rehabilitation, and care-management support. We aim to support diverse populations, including rural and underserved communities.

[Contact Us](https://www.wellinks.com/contact-us)

[Calculate Your Opportunity](https://www.wellinks.com/resources/rpm-opportunity-calculator)

Wellinks partners with health plans and care organizations to provide eligible members with virtual-first lung health support, remote monitoring, and access to a dedicated care team. If you’ve been invited to enroll in the Wellinks program and want to learn more, visit our patient information page.
